label: copy-phase input d late in long sequences (rare, threshold-like)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.002% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (89% of mass) when the fed-back input is d, with occasional weak firing on c or m. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and never at recall_idx<=2. It fires at recall_idx>=4 in long sequences (L=8-9 hold 91% of mass), so firing rate rises with t. Magnitude is narrow (0.07-0.16) and shows no clear modulation. Activations skew toward the step outputting 0 (48% of mass), then m, d, a, c. The predicate captures ~88% of activation mass, but only ~0.2% of late copy-phase d steps actually fire. Adding conditions on the next output or the previous token raises precision to only ~8%, so whatever selects the rare firing d steps was not found among the per-step or history variables.
